I. Problem Distinctions

Interpolation: Given a set of discrete points, find a curve or function that passes through all points. [Score 1]
Approximation: Given a set of discrete points, find a curve or function that is as close as possible to but not necessarily passing through all points, often used in noisy data situations. [Score 2]

II. Solution Differences

Interpolation: Polynomial interpolation (e.g. Lagrange interpolation, Newton interpolation), spline interpolation (e.g. cubic spline) [Score 3]
Approximation: Least squares method (polynomial approximation, spline approximation), Bezier curve fitting, smoothing methods [Score 4]

III. Advantage Comparison

Interpolation: Passes through all data points accurately, suitable for precise data modeling without noise [Score 5]
Approximation: Robust to noise or errors, suitable for data fitting and trend modeling [Score 6]

IV. Disadvantage Comparison

Interpolation: Sensitive to noise, high-order interpolation may cause oscillations (Runge phenomenon) [Score 7]
Approximation: Does not pass through original data points, may lose some details, and has weaker explanatory power [Score 8]

一、原理说明
梯形公式：将积分区间分割为若干小区间，在每个小区间内用直线连接函数值，形成梯形来近似积分。【给分点 1】
辛普森公式：将积分区间分割为偶数个小区间，在每两个小区间内用二次抛物线拟合函数，利用抛物线下的面积来近似积分。【给分点 2】

二、精度分析
梯形公式：误差阶为O(h²)，其中h为步长，适用于函数变化较为平缓的情况。【给分点 3】
辛普森公式：误差阶为O(h⁴)，精度比梯形公式高，对于光滑函数有更好的近似效果。【给分点 4】

三、适用场景
梯形公式：计算简单，适用于快速估算和函数变化不大的积分。【给分点 5】
辛普森公式：精度要求较高的数值积分，特别是被积函数较为光滑的情况。【给分点 6】
